    • deactivateTraining

      public Boolean deactivateTraining(Long trainingId)
      Deactivates a training program, making it unavailable for new participation. Maintains existing participation records while preventing new enrollments.

      Implementation note: Deactivates training and sends notifications to all administrators and managers about the deactivation.

      Specified by:
      deactivateTraining in interface TrainingService
      Parameters:
      trainingId - the unique identifier of the training to deactivate
      Returns:
      true if deactivation was successful, false otherwise

    • getTrainingsByFilters

      public List<TrainingDTO> getTrainingsByFilters(Long requesterId, TrainingFilter filters)
      Retrieves training programs based on specified filtering criteria. Supports complex filtering by area, status, date ranges, and other training attributes.

      Implementation note: Non-admin users can only view active trainings. Admin role check is performed before applying filters.

      Specified by:
      getTrainingsByFilters in interface TrainingService
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user making the request (used for authorization)
      filters - the filter criteria for training search
      Returns:
      a list of TrainingDTO objects matching the filter criteria

    • getUnparticipatedTrainingsByUserId

      public List<TrainingDTO> getUnparticipatedTrainingsByUserId(Long requesterId, Long userId)
      Retrieves training programs that a specific user has not yet participated in. Provides personalized training recommendations based on participation history.

      Implementation note: Verifies requester authorization (admin or user's manager) before returning unparticipated trainings for the specified user.

      Specified by:
      getUnparticipatedTrainingsByUserId in interface TrainingService
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user making the request (for authorization)
      userId - the ID of the user to find unparticipated trainings for
      Returns:
      a list of TrainingDTO objects representing available training programs
